text:
Retry the request of job 20261106-202436-ch54 with its goal unchanged: while the producer's cargo wrapper (crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs) holds a build slot, link the job's CARGO_TARGET_DIR path to the slot's warm target folder with athena_agent::env::BuildLink, as link_slot_target in crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs does, and drop the link after the command. Commands that take no slot keep today's behaviour. Fix every finding from the rejected retry 20261107-144832-7wsq (see its verification.json): (1) tests must not write and then run executables in the test process, because of the ETXTBSY rule; (2) after each slotted command, run the same workspace-output clean the checks run, so the producer's workspace crates do not build up in the shared slot; (3) get the slot target path from the state layout's own function, not a hard-coded name, and keep the CACHEDIR.TAG that make_target_dir writes; (4) when CARGO_TARGET_DIR is absent or cannot be linked, print a warning and do not run unlinked silently. The reading must match the request. Acceptance: tests show that a slotted command builds into the slot folder and the link is removed afterwards; that two commands in different jobs reuse one slot folder; that fmt and metadata do not touch the slot; that the D46 check still passes; and that no workspace-crate output stays in the slot. All tests pass. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The change to make producer cargo commands build in the build slot's warm folder was interrupted, then rejected on retry, and never retried; producers still build into private 12-19 GB folders
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs, verification.json, CHANGELOG.md
